meta.name: data-governance
meta.description: Establishes ownership, definitions, quality, access, and lineage for the organization's data. Use this when metrics disagree between teams, when nobody knows which dataset is authoritative, when setting up data ownership or access policy, when data quality is unreliable, or before opening a dataset to a wider audience.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清数据归属与口径,让指标对齐可信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队常为数据口径争吵,却找不到权威数据源
copy.tagline_en: Clarify data ownership and definitions for trustworthy metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team argues over metrics and lacks a trusted data source

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会帮忙建立数据治理规则：为业务指标写定义、指定负责人、检查数据质量、设定访问权限，并追踪数据从哪里来到哪里去。
howto.when: 当团队间指标口径不一致、不知道哪个数据集是权威、数据质量不可靠，或要设置数据归属/访问权限、向更多人开放数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我给‘收入’指标写一份清晰的定义，并说明计算方法和负责人。
检查一下‘用户表’今天的数据有没有异常，比如行数突然变成零。
say.note: Claude会进行数据质量测试并报告。

say.text: 这个‘订单明细’数据集的所有者是谁？访问权限是怎么设置的？
say.note: Claude会查询数据集的所有权和访问策略。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps establish data governance: it defines business metrics, assigns owners, checks data quality, sets access policies, and traces data lineage.
howto.when_en: Triggers when team metrics disagree, when it's unclear which dataset is authoritative, when data quality is unreliable, or when setting up data ownership/access or opening data to a wider audience.

say_en.text: Write a clear definition for 'revenue': computation and owner.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a metric dictionary entry.

say_en.text: Check 'users' table for anomalies, e.g., row count dropping to zero.
say_en.note: Claude will run data quality tests and report.

say_en.text: Who owns 'order details' dataset and how is access set?
say_en.note: Claude will look up ownership and access policy.
